page_title: Turn videos into blog articles in seconds

sources.entry: VideoToBlog - Convert YouTube videos to blog content in one click #free

summary.name: VideoToBlog
summary.one_liner: VideoToBlog converts YouTube videos into blog articles, which can be published directly to a site or sent as an email newsletter.
use_cases: Turn YouTube videos into blog posts
Publish video content to a WordPress site
Send video-based content as an email newsletter
Create SEO-oriented blog articles from video
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a tool that instantly converts YouTube videos into blog articles. Reviewer quotes mention structured posts with headings, screenshots and embedded calls to action, and processing of both video and audio files. Articles can be published directly to a site, including WordPress in one click, or sent as an email newsletter. The page itself gives few technical details beyond these claims.
notable: Handles both video and audio files according to reviewers
Can send generated articles as an email newsletter
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page; the directory listing tags it #free but the page itself does not confirm this
Page content is mostly testimonials; little detail on features or limits
